items.rationale: The swerve and impact are covered under §§2.6.1–2.6.3. Under §§7.1.7 and 7.1.10, the display accounts for €1,000 of the estimated €1,340 gross repair, which is below the cost of an equivalent new laptop; no deductible is stated.

The corner dent is covered even if it did not impair operation (§2.6.3(b)). The equivalent housing and fitting account for €340 of the €1,340 combined repair under §§7.1.7 and 7.1.10, with no separate deductible for this damage area.
Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.11 exclude cosmetic work on the old scuff because the impact did not cause it. The €35 figure is a conditional estimate only; the line is not payable.

Section 5.2.3 covers the necessary damage assessment after an insured impact, whether reimbursed to the policyholder or settled with the shop (§7.1.12). An estimated €60 gross is below the €250 event cap, and no repair credit is shown.
